text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: And next is... Here you go, Fine-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is... Oh, I get it! In that case, how 
about this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy halls, 
lively voices could be heard from one of 
the classrooms.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You guys sure are lively. Are you playing 
picture shiritori?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We are! Instead of using words, we take 
turns drawing pictures on the blackboard 
like this~...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's "Ramen", right? It definitely 
connects from "Mogura" (Mole), but it ends 
with an "n", you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! Fufufu, I messed up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You really do love ramen, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! Quirks like that make you 
so friendly that people almost forget 
you're from such an extraordinarily noble 
lineage~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? Doesn't ramen captivate 
everyone who meets it? Like the way the 
noodles entwine with the chef's special 
broth—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Is there anything else you've 
been hooked on lately besides ramen?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Hmm, let's see... Lately, I've really 
enjoyed taking photos too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A quick snap on a smartphone☆ It's 
wonderful to preserve memories so 
casually, isn't it♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Casually, huh... But couldn't you easily 
take photos back home, too...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, not quite, actually. Back then, it 
was just the "norm" for me, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, everyone. I have 
changed into the Tracen Academy uniform, 
so shall we begin the commemorative 
photoshoot?

text_block_list.name: Head Maid
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, please come right this way. 
We shall commence the photoshoot after 
applying your makeup. Lighting! Camera! 
Security!

text_block_list.name: Retainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, right here! Reflector board setup is 
complete!

text_block_list.name: Secret Service
text_block_list.text:
Eagle Squad! Photoshoot commencing. Heavy 
pedestrian traffic around the perimeter. 
Guard from above for any suspicious 
activity!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We also need to shoot in the gym uniform, 
correct? To show everyone what sort of 
culture I will be experiencing from now 
on.

text_block_list.name: Head Maid
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we shall bring the custom shoes 
tailored specifically to your legs 
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Secret Service
text_block_list.text:
Hounds Squad, do you copy? Deploy diamond 
formation centered on Her Highness! 
Accompany her running routine along with 
the camera crew!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your utmost care. I leave it 
in your capable hands.

text_block_list.name: Secret Service
text_block_list.text: Ma'am, yes ma'am!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Or something like that? I put everyone 
through quite a bit of trouble, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-That went way beyond my imagination...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Also, it's so delightful being able to 
take a picture and immediately share it 
with everyone. Just the other day, too...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on. Fine-san, these followers on 
your Umastagram, are they...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
World-renowned figures I've seen on TV are 
hitting "Like"... On a picture of 
mega-portion veggie ramen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-dong-dang-dong♪)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's the preliminary chime. Oh 
dear, I have to erase the blackboard!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It felt as though I had just caught a 
glimpse into a completely unbelievable 
world.
